It isn't sterile and may contain too much salt (sodium) or sulphate. Use freshly boiled tap water, cooled for no more than 30 minutes. In rare cases, such as contaminated tap water, still bottled water with no more than 200 mg/L sodium and 250 mg/L sulphate can be boiled and used. In a supply cut, ready-made formula is safest.
